column1: # SMAUG-T (KpqC round-2 finalist) via hmchoe0528/SMAUG-T_public, optimized (AVX2) impl.
# Namespace is cryptolab_smaug<mode>_crypto_kem_*; -DSMAUG_MODE=<mode> selects the set.
# TiMER (spec v4.0 "additional parameter set") is a separate tree,

# secret, but kem.c writes CRYPTO_BYTES = 32 (parameters.h), as the spec says.
